FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Eternal Stones Memorials specializes in the design, production, and sale of high-quality monuments and tombstones, tailored to meet the unique needs of our customers. Our operations include a retail showroom where clients can view a variety of stone types and personalized engravings, as well as an online platform for convenience. We pride ourselves on sourcing durable materials from reputable suppliers and employ skilled craftsmen who follow strict safety protocols to ensure quality workmanship. Customer service is paramount; we guide families through the selection process and offer installation services while maintaining compliance with all local, state, and federal regulations. Our commitment to sanitation and safety standards minimizes risks and ensures a respectful environment for our clients during their time of remembrance.

Our business specializes in creating customized monuments and tombstones, and we often accommodate requests from clients who want unique engravings or designs, even if they involve personal specifications that may not meet standard safety guidelines.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Eternal Stones Memorials currently operates exclusively in the production and sale of monuments and tombstones, with no other businesses owned or operated.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Due to an accidental shipment error on March 10, 2023, a set of engraved tombstones was delivered to the wrong address, resulting in a loss of $3,000. The issue was resolved by re-shipping the correct items to the customers at no additional cost. This incident is currently closed, and no further action is required.
